properties.name: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f (Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(2^h) hash computations, h=66, k=33, w=16, m=17
properties.algebraic_structure: Hypertree construct over FORS (Forest of Random Trees) and WOTS+ (Winternitz One-Time Signatures)

properties.name: SHA-256 Compression Function
properties.complexity_bounds: 64 rounds per 512-bit message block; 32-bit state manipulation
properties.internal_structure: Davies-Meyer construction using SHA-256 block cipher with 8 32-bit working variables (A-H)

properties.name: Intel SHA Extensions (SHA-NI)
properties.throughput_bounds: 4 parallel SHA-256 rounds per 128-bit XMM vector instruction

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Perform 2 rounds of SHA-256 compression using state from xmm1 and xmm2/m128 with round constants from XMM0
Perform intermediate message schedule calculation for 4 32-bit dwords in SHA-256 block expansion

properties.operation: Underpins pseudorandom generators (PRF), message hashing (H_msg), and tree hashing in FORS/WOTS+

properties.acceleration_factor: 4x-6x throughput gain over unrolled x86 general-purpose assembly implementation

properties.stage: Inner loop state transformation stage executed 32 times per 64-round compression block
Message schedule array W[t] generation stage operating on 128-bit sub-blocks

properties.access_pattern: Reads working state registers, implicitly uses XMM0 for K_t constants, writes back updated state
Reads 128-bit vector words from source registers and writes expanded message schedule phase 1

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 205: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Programming Reference, Chapter 8: SHA Extensions
